title: aHotAirBalloonRide.com
specs: Flights at sunrise when winds are lightest
Pilot has over 40 years combined ballooning experience
No restrictions on age but must be agile enough to climb in and out of basket and stand for duration
Advise operator of any medical condition
Limited number of passengers share the flight
Private flights available for special occasions such as proposals, anniversaries, and bucket list flights
includes: Celebratory toast with champagne or non-alcoholic drink
blurb: Guests meet before dawn in the World Golf Village area of Saint Augustine and are driven to a launch site chosen based on wind and weather. Flights last approximately 30 minutes to an hour depending on weather, with a total experience time of 3-4 hours. The flight ends with a celebratory toast and a traditional Balloonists’ Prayer.
extraNote: No refunds · Flights are wind and weather permitting · If pilot cancels due to weather or other uncontrollable circumstances, flight will be rescheduled or boarding pass issued for later date · If customer cancels within 24 hours of flight time, half of original cost is non-refundable · No-call, no-show or late arrival voids refund · World Golf Village area of Saint Augustine
